title: Select export fields
interactive: there is no separate field-selection command: the field list is passed positionally in /file/export/ascii
notes: There is NO TUI command for selecting export fields in the KB: fields are a positional argument `/file/export/ascii <file> <surfaces> () yes <fields> () yes` (internal names: temperature, velocity-magnitude, x-velocity, pressure, density, specific-heat-cp, thermal-conductivity-lam, viscosity-lam, heat-flux). Stub recipe for a compiler step: implement it as file.export-ascii parameters, do not emit a separate journal line.
